offline.model: Keep run 6 add-to-profile-seal 47.048170s (includes 32.533s raw reading, retention/start and profile tail). After: add both handoffs 0.277091s + full raw preflight 3.429600s BEFORE mapping execution + natural package 3.930728s + carried processing allowance 3.917s. Mapping is actually enqueued during the first handoff, at 0.089561s. Before uses both handoffs, current admission, whole mapping, comparison and first natural package. No officer time subtracted.
offline.allowance: 3.917s = run 6 draft entry to first intake-run enqueue 2.019s + first intake-run dispatch to map 1.898s. Conservatively adds some folding work already timed; excludes dispatcher contention and browser polling changes.
offline.boundedComparison: Parallel validation alongside checks modelled 66.450s (preflight 7.707s, natural cut 7.549s). Hypothesis: concurrent compilation/tests inflate CPU/I/O. One serial comparison only; success <60s with identical first package/hash, stop after it either way. Result 58.603s; stopped. This is not a live SLA proof.

changes: prepareReaders admits the currently approved mapping even from an obsolete wake, before the obsolete step claim/completion; later handoffs no longer precede admission.

acceptDataSlot queues intake in the same fenced publication transaction, first chunk and every later chunk. A private optional mappedThrough job pin distinguishes watermarks; tests prove why it is needed. Public contracts unchanged.

comparePrefix checks sealed raw chunks in bounded groups of eight independently of mapping closure, using the existing normalizer and post-read lease fence. It retains first used-field failure and all late duplicate indices before any cut.

draft follows committed mapped chunks, retains the unfinished cutter while waiting, never closes a package at a publication boundary, yields after a streaming cut, resumes from the last stored locator and closes only on valid EOF. All final record/count/closure fences remain.

parity.tests: Six added tests plus strengthened regressions: first/later publication wake, obsolete approved admission including open prefix, watermark-only dispatch freshness, closure counts, streaming/resumed ordered hashes, no suffix reread, late duplicates, field drift, expired post-read lease. Existing access/source/code/hash, pressure and one-live-attempt tests pass.
